freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 注册即享免费模型额度(按周期重置),可免费调用 DeepSeek V4 Flash、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 与 MiMo V2.5;持续补充限免促销模型。提供 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容接口。
freeTierSummary.en: Free monthly allowance after sign-up (resets each period) covering DeepSeek V4 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and MiMo V2.5, with promotional free models added over time. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
